title: MIFARE Plus Cards
description: MIFARE Plus cards for upgrading MIFARE Classic systems to AES-based security while preserving migration flexibility across existing infrastructures.
summary: MIFARE Plus cards help projects move from MIFARE Classic to AES-based security while preserving a practical migration path across existing readers and installed systems.
Seamless Upgrade: MIFARE Plus® allows a smooth transition from existing MIFARE Classic® installations with minimal effort.
Backward Compatibility: It maintains compatibility with MIFARE Classic, ensuring a straightforward migration path.
